answer: Declared work windows choke sybil farms at the inlet. Each alias picks one 4 hour window per epoch, and only jobs finished inside that window pay. The window choice is written to an anchor log, so an operator running 100 aliases must spread them across the clock instead of firing them all at once. At the zenith of each window the network samples 5 finished jobs and checks them against the log. Two aliases whose windows match exactly and whose outputs share over 70 percent of their text count as one operator. Both lose 21 epochs of pay, and their windows stay shut for 30 epochs.
